tvShow.name: Ahsoka
tvShow.overview: Former Jedi Knight Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

episodes.name: Ahsoka: Legacy
episodes.overview: Join cast and crew for a look at developing Ahsoka's live-action series.

episodes.name: Path of the Apprentice
episodes.overview: Explore the dynamic of Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka within the world between worlds.

episodes.name: Ghosts of the Past
episodes.overview: Go deep with a spotlight on Ahsoka’s allies: Sabine, Hera, Ezra and Chopper.

episodes.name: Darkness Rising
episodes.overview: Uncover the secrets of Ahsoka's foes.

episodes.name: Part One: Master and Apprentice
episodes.overview: A valuable prisoner escapes New Republic custody; a search for answers reunites two old friends.

episodes.name: Part Two: Toil and Trouble
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and General Hera Syndulla travel to New Republic shipyards and make an unexpected discovery.

episodes.name: Part Three: Time to Fly
episodes.overview: Hera tangles with New Republic politics while Ahsoka and Sabine Wren voyage to a distant planet.

episodes.name: Part Four: Fallen Jedi
episodes.overview: Hera risks her career to help her friends while Ahsoka and Sabine confront enemies.

episodes.name: Part Five: Shadow Warrior
episodes.overview: Ahsoka confronts her past, while Hera and her allies undertake a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Part Six: Far, Far Away
episodes.overview: The search for Grand Admiral Thrawn reaches beyond the limits of the galaxy.

episodes.name: Part Seven: Dreams and Madness
episodes.overview: Hera must answer to the New Republic, while far, far away, a reunion takes place.

episodes.name: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord
episodes.overview: The heroes race to prevent Grand Admiral Thrawn's escape.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Ahsoka Tano, the former Padawan of Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars, investigates a mysterious new threat to the galaxy after the fall of the Empire. As she reunites with her former apprentice, Sabine Wren, rumors of the villainous Thrawn's return are on the rise.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 continues the story of Ahsoka Tano and her extraordinary journey beyond the known galaxy. As Ahsoka and her Jedi apprentice Sabine Wren travel across a mysterious and perilous world to find their way home, their friends Hera, Ezra, Zeb, and Chopper, must face the powerful Grand Admiral Thrawn and his sinister allies, who seek to plunge the New Republic into war.

reviews.author: TheEnrichtifyer
reviews.content:
It is a show that knows more than anything how to waste your time. Very little is accomplished over the season, and the show has little to no character arcs. For no reason, there are long pauses during dialogue between 2 people and there is no reason for it other than to pat out the runtime. The characters and bland and have little story arcs or their arc makes no sense. Speaking of, so many stupid things happen in this show that make no sense from the opening scene of episode 1 to the last scene of episode 8. Why do the robots initiate self-destruct and say it out loud so Ahsoka can escape? Why do they take forever to self-destruct? Why not blow up immediately so Ahsoka just dies and the story ends? Why does Sabine survive a lightsaber stab wound? What is Baylon Skol after? Why is there a random map to Thrawn on this random planet? These and many more questions plague the show and are never answered. And I highly doubt they will be answered in season 2.

Sorry Dave, but you didn't save Star Wars. You just showed it is as dead as it was when Disney bought the rights to it. Do us a favor Dave and take some writing lessons cause your scripts suck. Do better.

3/10
